links.comparator_used: The same pipeline applied to the external cohort as-is, without fine-tuning on external data
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance (AUC, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity) for neoplastic vs non-neoplastic ICH on the external validation cohort
links.effect: Without fine-tuning: AUC 68%, Acc 66%, sensitivity 64%, specificity 67%. After fine-tuning on a small external subset: AUC 70%, Acc 70%, sensitivity 70%, specificity 71%.
links.quote: Fine-tuning on a selected small subset of the external cohort enhanced performance, achieving an AUC and accuracy of 70% (sensitivity 70%; specificity 71%).

design_hint: local fine-tuning/recalibration on external site data
